title: 第2529章 幽影四卫现第2528章 得加钱
slug: 顶级悟性从修炼基础剑法开始
lines: “姬族长，你觉得我敢在这里跟你谈条件，我会没有依仗吗？”
就在姬玲珑和那两位刚刚显露气息、尚未现身的姬氏长老心头警兆狂升的刹那，异变陡生。
“轰轰轰轰！”
四股更加恐怖、更加霸道、更加纯粹的半步神皇巅峰威压，如同四颗毁灭星辰骤然降临！
毫无征兆地在小院上方的虚空轰然爆发！
空间剧烈扭曲、塌陷！无形的禁锢之力瞬间覆盖全场，将姬玲珑三人刚刚凝聚的威压硬生生压了回去！
紧接着，四道身影如同从虚无中踏出，无声无息地出现在小院上空。
他们身着样式古朴的暗色战甲，面容模糊不清，仿佛笼罩在淡淡的阴影之中，唯有一双双冰冷的眼眸，如同深渊寒星，漠然地俯视着下方。
他们身上散发的气息，纯粹、冰冷、充满了毁灭性的杀伐之意，赫然都是半步神皇巅峰之境！随便一位，都不弱于姬玲珑和姜伊人。
这突如其来的惊天变故，让姬玲珑和她身后刚刚显露出身形、同样白发苍苍、气息渊深的两位姬氏太上长老瞬间面色剧变！
姜伊人脸上也露出了难以掩饰的震惊！
这四人……她从未见过！
气息之强，竟不弱于姬玲珑！
他们是如何做到无声无息出现在这里的？
姬玲珑强行压下心头的惊骇，面色阴沉如水，抬头死死盯着那四道如同死神般的身影，厉声喝问，声音中充满了惊怒与难以置信：
“你们是谁？！你们……是怎么进来的？！”
幽影四卫如同四尊冰冷的雕塑，悬立虚空，对姬玲珑的质问置若罔闻。
他们只是静静地站在那里，四股半步神皇巅峰的恐怖威压如同实质的潮水，汹涌地席卷整个虚空，牢牢锁定着下方的姬玲珑三人，以及那两位面色凝重到了极点的姬氏太上长老。
冰冷的沉默，比任何回答都更具压迫感。
小院内的空气，仿佛被这无声的威压冻结了。
姜伊人此刻只觉得自己的思绪像是被投入了风暴旋涡的核心。
她那双深邃如寒潭的眼眸，在散发着半步神皇巅峰恐怖威压的幽影四卫身上扫过，又在方羽那张平静得近乎漠然的脸庞上停留，最后落在姬玲珑那阴沉得几乎滴水的脸上。
信息量太大了！
方羽不仅活着出来，拿到了至关重要的轩辕碎片，而如今竟然还隐藏着如此恐怖的力量？
四位半步神皇巅峰的护道者！
这阵容，足以在虚神界任何地方横着走，难怪他敢在古神族腹地，面对姬玲珑的威压也寸步不让。
她心中念头急转，最终选择了一个最稳妥的姿态，无声无息地站到了方羽身侧稍后的位置。
没有言语，但这个动作本身，就是一种无声的支持和立场宣示。至于心中的疑问，等会离开古神族，她相信方羽自然会为她解惑。
姬玲珑自然注意到了姜伊人的动作，心头更沉一分。
她强压下被幽影四卫震慑的惊怒，目光如同淬毒的冰锥，死死钉在方羽身上。
她知道这四人能够无声无息穿透姬氏族地的重重禁制，精准降临此地，必然与眼前这个看似人畜无害的青年有直接关系！
“四位半步神皇巅峰，好大的手笔！”
content_en:
"Chief Ji, do you think if I dare to negotiate terms with you here, I will have no one to rely on?"
At the moment when Ji Linglong and the two elders of the Ji family, who had just revealed their presence but had not yet appeared, were feeling alarmed, a sudden change occurred.
"Boom boom boom!"
Four more terrifying, more domineering, and more pure peak pressure of the Half-Step God Emperor suddenly descended like four stars of destruction!
Without warning, it exploded in the void above the small courtyard!
The space is violently distorted and collapsed! The invisible force of confinement instantly covered the entire scene, forcing back the pressure that Ji Linglong and the others had just gathered!
Immediately afterwards, four figures seemed to step out of nothingness and appeared silently in the sky above the small courtyard.
They were wearing simple dark armor, their faces were blurred, as if shrouded in light shadows, only a pair of cold eyes, like cold stars in the abyss, looked down indifferently.
The aura exuding from their bodies was pure, cold, and full of destructive killing intent. They were all half-step to the peak of the God Emperor! No one is weaker than Ji Linglong and Jiang Yiren.
This sudden and shocking change caused the expressions of Ji Linglong and the two Supreme Elders of the Ji family who had just revealed their figures behind her to suddenly change dramatically!
Jiang Yiren's face also showed unconcealable shock!
These four people...she has never seen before!
The aura is not weaker than Ji Linglong's!
How did they manage to appear here silently?
Ji Linglong suppressed the fear in her heart, her face was as gloomy as water, she raised her head and stared at the four figures that looked like the gods of death, and shouted sternly, her voice full of shock, anger and disbelief:
"Who are you?! How...how did you get in?!"
The four shadowy guards were like four cold sculptures, hanging in the void, turning a deaf ear to Ji Linglong's questions.
They just stood there quietly, and the terrifying coercion of the four half-step God Emperors was like a real tide, sweeping across the entire void, firmly locking the three people of Ji Linglong below, as well as the two Supreme Elders of the Ji family with extremely solemn expressions.
The cold silence was more oppressive than any answer.
The air in the small courtyard seemed to be frozen by this silent pressure.
At this moment, Jiang Yiren felt as if her thoughts were being thrown into the core of a storm vortex.
Her eyes, as deep as a cold pool, glanced at the four shadow guards who exuded the terrifying pressure of the half-step God Emperor, then stopped at Fang Yu's face that was so calm and almost indifferent, and finally landed on Ji Linglong's face that was so gloomy that it was almost dripping with water.
There is so much information!
Fang Yu not only came out alive and got the crucial Xuanyuan fragment, but now he still hides such terrifying power?
Four guardians who are half a step to the peak of the God Emperor!
This lineup is enough to move sideways anywhere in the Virtual God Realm. No wonder he dares to face the pressure of Ji Linglong in the hinterland of the Ancient God Clan and refuses to give in.
Her thoughts raced in her mind, and she finally chose the safest posture and stood silently behind Fang Yu.
There are no words, but the action itself is a silent statement of support and position. As for the questions in her heart, she believed that Fang Yu would naturally answer her questions after she left the Ancient God Clan.
Ji Linglong naturally noticed Jiang Yiren's movements, and her heart became even heavier.
She suppressed the shock and anger of being frightened by the four shadow guards, and her eyes were like poisonous ice picks, nailing Fang Yu.
She knew that the ability of these four people to silently penetrate the many restrictions of the Ji clan and arrive here accurately must be directly related to the seemingly harmless young man in front of them!
"Four half-step god emperors at the peak of their powers, what a big deal!"
